pipelines.name: Evals

steps.name: Verify eval credentials
steps.run:
status=0
models=("$WARDEN_EVAL_MODEL")
if [ -n "$WARDEN_EVAL_JUDGE_MODEL" ] && [ "$WARDEN_EVAL_JUDGE_MODEL" != "$WARDEN_EVAL_MODEL" ]; then
  models+=("$WARDEN_EVAL_JUDGE_MODEL")
fi
for model in "${models[@]}"; do
  if [[ "$model" != */* ]]; then
    echo "::error::Eval model '$model' must be a provider/model selector"
    status=1
    continue
  fi
  provider="${model%%/*}"
  key_var="WARDEN_$(echo "$provider" | tr '[:lower:]-' '[:upper:]_')_API_KEY"
  if [ -z "${!key_var:-}" ]; then
    echo "::error::$key_var is required to run evals with $model"
    status=1
  fi
done
exit "$status"

steps.name: Run evals
steps.run:
set +e
pnpm evals
status=$?
if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "::notice title=Individual evals missed::pnpm evals exited with $status. The Evaluation Results baseline check determines CI pass/fail."
fi
exit 0
